cityclerk@pawtucketri.com until 4:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting.   
Please type COUNCIL INPUT in the Subject box.

FROM:       Richard J. Goldstein, MMC, City Clerk 
 
DATE:          November 2, 2026 
 
SUBJECT: ORDINANCE COMMITTEE  
________________________________ 
 
You are requested to attend a  meeting of the City Council Ordinance Committee, to be held on 
Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 5:45 p.m., at the Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, 1st 
Floor - Room 140, Pawtucket, Rhode Island. 
 
The purpose of this meeting is for discussion and/or consideration of the following: 
 
1. PUBLIC INPUT PERIOD Must Sign-in or Join via Zoom 10 minutes prior to meeting. 
 
2. Review of Chapter 167 of the Code of Ordinances of the City of Pawtucket, 1996, entitled “Circuses 
and Carnivals” 
 
 
This meeting is being called by Councilor David P. Moran, Chair, Ordinance Committee.
